verdict.rationale: The product's own llms.txt explicitly declares 'Public API: None', and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404. The only API mention (2fas-docs-22) is forward-looking ('you'll be able to') and describes an integration for service providers, not a documented API a user can call to drive 2FAS. The agent-friendly docs plumbing (llms.txt, .md mirrors) is an adjacent feature, not a callable API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
